subject: Re: Pricing: per-token match + commit tiers (BlueWave)
messages:
From: Sasha Cole <sasha@bluewave.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluewave.ai
Date: 2026-08-10T14:12:00-04:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing inquiry — per-token + commit tiers

Hi Priyom / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re close to a decision but pricing is the gating factor. We run two production features that will generate ~8–12M tokens/mo across a mix of short chat replies and long-form generation spikes.

BlueWave is evaluating Redwood Hosted vs running models on cloud endpoints (we have quotes from OpenAI and Anthropic). To move forward quickly, procurement asked if Redwood can provide: 1) a per-token committed rate that is competitive with OpenAI’s effective blended rate for our profile, 2) an option for a 6–12 month commit with step-down pricing at volume, and 3) confirmation about token billing granularity (per-token vs per-1k).

I attached our RFQ and a small sample of monthly token distribution. Can you share a proposal we can circulate to our procurement/legal? Timebox: we’d like a response by Tuesday so we can include it in our vendor review next week.

Thanks,
Sasha
Sasha Cole
Head of Product
BlueWave Analytics

Attachment: BlueWave-RFQ-Aug2026.pdf
Attachment: bluewave_usage_sample.csv

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Cole <sasha@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T16:08:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry — per-token + commit tiers

Hi Sasha — great to hear from you and thanks for the RFQ. We appreciate the clear volume profile. Quick summary up front: we can offer a committed-hosted rate that matches the effective per-token economics you’ve seen on OpenAI for the same usage mix, subject to a 6-month minimum term and a baseline commit.

To be concrete, based on the sample you shared and assuming a 6-month commitment at ~10M tokens/mo, here’s a preliminary offer we can firm up with procurement:
- Blended committed rate: $0.80 per 1k tokens (blended across chat & generation tiers) — net effective match to their quoted blended rate
- Step-downs: 10M–20M: $0.75/1k; >20M: $0.65/1k (available after a 30-day usage ramp)
- Billing: billed per 1k tokens with millisecond-level metering; invoices show granularity and per-route breakdowns

Why choose Redwood Hosted for this commit:
- Predictable unit economics with token-level cost breakdowns in the Console
- Smart routing to lower-cost model variants automatically when latency/cost policies allow
- SLA-backed latency targets on committed tiers and dedicated support during onboarding

I’ve attached a short proposal stub and will loop in Rishi (sales director) for approval of any out-of-cycle discounts. If that direction works, we’ll produce a formal proposal and DocuSign package by EOD Monday.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood-Proposal-BlueWave-Aug2026.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T16:15:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: BlueWave pricing inquiry — request for approval

FW: Sasha from BlueWave. RFQ attached — they asked for a match to OpenAI blended per-token. Proposed committed blended rate at scale: $0.80/1k with steppers down to $0.65/1k. We’re looking at ~10M/mo initial, ramp to 20M+.

Asking for:
- Rishi: confirmation we can approve a 6-month commit at the $0.80/1k blended without legal review on price (we’ll still send the standard T&Cs).
- Lauren: can Legal/Finance fast-track a 6-month SOW + sample invoice terms? Procurement may request shorter payment windows.

Notes: they specifically prefer hosted (not private) for speed to production. They mentioned Anthropic/Cloud endpoints as secondary comparison in the RFQ.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T17:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BlueWave pricing inquiry — request for approval

Priyom — approve the proposed structure. A few guardrails:
- Lock the 6-month term with a clause for a usage true-up at the end of quarter if they under-deliver <80% of committed tokens
- Offer an optional 12-month term that drops the blended starting point another 10% (authorized)
- No custom SLA changes unless they commit to an annual or Dedicated contract

Loop Legal and Finance on the SOW. If procurement pushes for lower upfront, consider a phased commit (3mo trial with convertible credits to the 6mo commit).

Rishi

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Cole <sasha@bluewave.ai>, procurement@bluewave.ai
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:28:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry — per-token + commit tiers

Sasha — thanks for the fast turnaround. Per internal approvals, here is a formalized offer:

Summary (6-month commit)
- Baseline commit: 60M tokens over 6 months (~10M/mo)
- Blended starting rate: $0.80 per 1k tokens
- Step-down: 60M–120M total over term: $0.75/1k; >120M: $0.65/1k
- Billing & metering: per 1k tokens; monthly invoices with per-route breakdowns.
- Term options: 6-month firm or 12-month firm (12-month reduces blended starting rate by 10%).
- True-up: usage true-up at end of term if consumption <80% of committed volume

Next steps:
1) I’ll upload this to HubSpot and generate a DocuSign envelope for the commitment (link below).
2) If procurement wants a 3-month convertible trial, we can do an interim credit structure (apply credits toward the 6-month commit).
3) Legal: standard Hosted T&Cs (no Dedicated SLA changes).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.net/Member/Envelope?envelopeId=abc-123

Attached: Redwood-Proposal-BlueWave-Aug2026.pdf (formal pricing table + example invoice)

Looking forward to your thoughts — can sign and get infra access provisioned within 48 hours once the envelope is complete.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-Proposal-BlueWave-Aug2026.pdf

—Sasha
